questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

There is no doubt that Oltmans is (1)/ a very good coach and helped an (2)/ Indian cricket team take bold strides. (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.solution: The error lies in part 2 of the sentence as the article 'an' is incorrect and must be replaced with 'the' as the Indian cricket team is something specific.'An' is used to refer to one object. It should read as:'a very good coach and helped the..'

questions.question:

The rival teams scored three goals (1)/ with 10 circle penetrations against us and (2)/ we did scored just one off 15.(3)/ No Error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in part (3) is with the verb form "did scored." When using "did" for emphasis or to form a past tense question or negative, the main verb should be in its base form, making the correct construction "did score" rather than "did scored."
 
• The phrase "off 15" is correctly written as "o

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

Only one of the students ______ not done the homework given yesterday.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Has'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The verb here should be singular as the subject is singular, which is 'one of the students.'
 
• It refers to one student only. Moreover the verb 'done' hints us that the verb here should be in present perfect tense.
 
• Thus 'has' fits here correctly. Option 2 is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

questions.question: If 6 $ 4 @ 6 = 18 and 7 $ 6 @ 7 = 35, then9 $ 3 @ 9 = ?
questions.solution:
Here $ means × and @ means –,

So the given expression becomes,

6 $ 4 @ 6 → 6 × 4 – 6 = 18

7 $ 6 @ 7 → 7 × 6 – 7 = 35

Similarly,

9 $ 3 @ 9 → 9 × 3 – 9 = 18

Hence the answer is 18.

questions.question:
Which of the following statement/s is/are true?

questions.solution:
Statement I: 6³⁰⁰ > 16²⁰⁰

⇒ 16²⁰⁰ = (16²)¹⁰⁰ = 256¹⁰⁰

Hence 6³⁰⁰ > 16²⁰⁰ = 216¹⁰⁰ > 256¹⁰⁰ is false.

Statement II: 4³⁰⁰ > 7²⁰⁰

⇒ 4³⁰⁰ = (4³)¹⁰⁰ = 64¹⁰⁰

⇒ 7²⁰⁰ = (7²)¹⁰⁰ = 49¹⁰⁰

Hence 4³⁰⁰ > 7²⁰⁰ = 64¹⁰⁰ > 49¹⁰⁰ is true.

 From above series, last term = 99, First term = 3 and Difference = 6

questions.question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 5 days and A alone can do it in 30 days. B alone can do the work in how many days?
questions.solution:
Given,

A and B together can do a work in 5 days.

(A + B)’s one day work = 1/5

A can do the same work in 30 days.

A’s one day work = 1/30

Then,

B’s one day work = (A + B)’s one day work - A’s one day work

B’s one day work = 1/5 - 1/30 = (6 - 1)/30 = 5/30 = 1/6

Hence, B can do the same work = 6 days

questions.question: Three taps A, B and C can fill a tank in 10, 12 and 15 hours respectively. How long (in hours) would the three taps take to fill the tank if all of them are opened together?

B can fill the tank in 12 hours

∴ B’s one hour work = 1/12

C can fill the tank in 15 hours.

C’s one hour work = 1/15

Then, (A + B + C)’s one hour work = 1/10 + 1/12 + 1/15 = (6 + 5 + 4)/60 = 1/4

Hence, (A + B + C) can fill the tank in 4 hours.

questions.question: What is the change in the direction of light by a mirror called ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Reflection of light

__
 
• The process through which light rays falling on the surface of an object are sent back is called a reflection of light.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Reflection: **The phenomena in which **light ray is sent back into the same medium** from which it is coming, on **interaction with boundary,** is called reflection.
 
• **Laws of reflection:**

 
• Angle of incidence **(θi)** = Angle of reflection **(θr)**
 
• The **incident ray, the reflected ray, and normal** to the surface of incidence always lies in the same plane.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c0a9c7cdbacc21654088662dc791bc707d61d319eef7dfc8013f07612d0275f.png] 

 
• **Refraction:** When a ray of light passes from **one medium to another** it suffers a **change in direction** at the boundary of two media is called refraction.

 
• The change in direction **because the speed of light travels at different speeds **in different mediums.
 
• Refractive Index of a medium defines that it is denser or rarer
 
• **Refractive Index = Speed of light in Vacuum /speed of light in that medium.**
 
• **Refractive Index = η = c/v** where, c = Speed of light in Vacuum, v = speed of light in that medium.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82339a0de627554b07235929cdd32b43851718b65b7114397e275f2df207692c.png]

questions.question: The autotrophs or the producers exist at which trophic level of the food chain?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**First.**__

__Explanation:__

Feeding relation in the natural surrounding:

Food chain: 

__
 
• A food chain shows the feeding relationship between different organisms in a particular environment and/or habitat.
 
• A food chain shows how energy is passed from the sun to producers, from producers to consumers, and from consumers to decomposes such as fungi.
 
• They also show how animals depend on other organisms for food.

Tropic level: 

 
• Based on the source of their nutrition or food, organisms occupy a specific place in the food chain that is known as their trophic level.
 
• Producers belong to the first trophic level, herbivores (primary consumer) to the second and carnivores (secondary consumer) to the third. The important point to note is that the amount of energy decreases at successive trophic levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/149da41b2e58def7608e4afb88e8bd29b90d52c1d6f0d4542f251b74e5e38052.png] 

 
• Primary producers are at first tropic level - They produce food with their own with the help of photosynthesis. Ex- plants,trees.
 
• Primary Consumers are the herbivore's animals, whose nutrition is directly based on plant products. Ex- Cow, deer, grasshoppers, small insects etc.
 
• Secondary consumers are carnivorous animals Like- small birds, wolfs etc.
 
• Tertiary Consumers are also carnivorous but they feed on secondary consumers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Only 10% of energy is transferred to higher levels from the previous one. So, the demand for food is more in higher levels. So, the food chain does not go for more than 3-4 tropic levels. This leads to more complex food forms known as a food web.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dd88533bd479397c8ff098b2f7d94cd87266b920004f4f2f9d17ef4fb30dd9b.png] 

 
• Primary (100%) → First level/ Primary (10%) → Second-level/ Secondary (1%) → Third level / Tertiary (0.1%).

questions.question: Who is the author of the book named “Unhappy India”?
questions.solution:
Lala Lajpat Rai was the author of “Unhappy India”. He also authored the following published books.

 
• The Story of My Deportation, 1908
 
• Arya Samaj, 1915.
 
• The United States of America: A Hindu’s Impression, 1916.
 
• Unhappy India, 1928.
 
• England's Debt to India, 1917.

questions.question: Which organization has ruled that China's claim of historical rights over South China sea have no legal basis?
questions.solution:
• The South China Sea disputes involve both island and maritime claims among several sovereign states within the region, namely Brunei, the People's Republic of China (PRC), Republic of China (Taiwan), Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Vietnam.
 
• In July 2016, an arbitration tribunal constituted under Annex VII of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) ruled against the PRC's maritime claims in Philippines* v. *China.

questions.question: Which project allows the shipping segment from Kolkata to Sittwe in Myanmar?
questions.solution: The Kaladan Multi-Modal Transit Transport Project is a project that will connect the eastern Indian seaport of Kolkata with Sittwe seaport in Rakhine State, Myanmar by sea. This project will reduce the distance from Kolkata to Sittwe by approximately 1328 km and will reduce the need to transport the goods through the narrow Siliguri corridor, also known as Chicken's Neck.
